summary.name: 百度网盘 (Baidu Netdisk)
summary.one_liner: Baidu Netdisk is a personal cloud storage and file-sharing service for backing up, previewing, and sharing files from computers and phones.
use_cases: back up files from computer and phone to the cloud
scan paper documents and extract text with OCR
edit Word, PowerPoint and Excel files online
watch videos on a smart TV or car display
sync files and restore older versions
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Baidu Netdisk as a cloud service for backing up, previewing, and sharing files from computers and phones. It offers smart search by title, image type, and text within images. An OCR scanning feature extracts text from paper documents, and files are synced automatically across devices with version history restore. Documents can be opened and edited online (Word, PPT, Excel), and audio and video can be played directly. It also lists integrations with smart TVs, car systems, smart speakers, and children's education devices, plus an enterprise edition for organizational file management.
notable: OCR scanning of paper documents, cards, and exam papers
Smart TV, car system, and smart speaker integrations
Enterprise edition for organizational file management
Online editing of Word, PPT, and Excel files
caveats: Some features are for members only, per the page
Some mini-program features are marked as coming soon
Device integrations are limited to listed brands and models
